name: neutrix-health-app
description: Neutrix Health Android app (Capacitor). Opens the live Neutrix website in its own app window, works offline, syncs with the website.

scripts.setup:android: npx cap add android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#000000' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#000000' --splashBackgroundColor '#000000' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#000000' && node scripts/patch-android.js && npx cap sync android
